# Result.QuerySuggestionText property

This holds the text which can be shown as a query suggestion.

```csharp
public string QuerySuggestionText { get; set; }
```

## Remarks

When a value is not set, the [`Title`](./Title.md) will be used. Do not include the action keyword prefix because Flow prepends it automatically. If the it does not start with the query text, it will not be shown as a suggestion. So make sure to set this value to start with the query text.
